title: 844. Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes

examples.explanation: A four-edge walk covers all five nodes.

hints: Expand the state to (mask, node): which nodes are visited plus the current endpoint.
Start breadth-first search from every node with its own single-bit mask; the first time the full mask appears is optimal.
With n up to 12 there are at most n * 2^n states, easily fast enough.
